steps.en: The officer picks cancel or proceed on the refund advice
steps.id: Officer memilih cancel atau proceed pada refund advice
steps.why_en: No decision field or button for refunds exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada field atau tombol keputusan untuk refund.

steps.en: The officer adds remarks to the decision
steps.why_en: There is no place to store or enter refund remarks.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada tempat untuk mengisi atau menyimpan remarks refund.

steps.en: The decision goes to the 2OIC for approval
steps.why_en: The approval page is commented out and no 2OIC role or routing exists.
steps.why_id: Halaman approval di-comment dan tidak ada role atau routing 2OIC.

steps.en: OCMS starts the refund with the Payment Gateway
steps.id: OCMS memulai refund ke Payment Gateway
steps.why_en: The only gateway call sends payments for reconciliation, not refunds.
steps.why_id: Satu-satunya panggilan gateway mengirim pembayaran untuk rekonsiliasi, bukan refund.

steps.en: OCMS starts the refund with Cumulus
steps.why_en: No connection to Cumulus exists in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi ke Cumulus di code.
